|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">惑星ジャンドゥーン出身のブリジット男性。帝国の目を逃れて辺境のタトゥウィーンに潜んでいる。帝国の手が伸びる前に、アウターリムへの脱出手段を得ようとしている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Tzizvvt.

'''Card text:'''
During your deploy phase only, you may use 1 Force to “fly” (move) up to two locations away. Power +1 at Trash Compactor, a Dagobah location card, or the same location card as Dark Waters or Tarkin.

'''Lore:'''
A male Brizzit from the planet Jandoon. He is hiding from the Empire on remote Tatooine. He hopes to get passage to the Outer Rim before the Empire reaches him.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses 「よどみきった汚水」 for Dark Waters and 「ゴミ圧縮装置」 for Trash Compactor.
